annotations.title: Find the official Instagram recovery route

description: Free and read-only. For the legitimate owner of an Instagram account that was hacked, disabled, locked at a checkpoint, locked by lost 2-factor, or whose email and phone are no longer reachable, returns the official recovery route, the same one as the free checker on essentras.com. Ask only what happened; never the handle, email, phone, password or a code. Returns the route, the owner’s own first step, Instagram’s official help pages with the date they were read, Meta’s position on timing, scam warning signs, and the Essentras recovery service with its current price. Official channels only: no hacking and no account access. Meta decides, and nobody can promise a recovery or a timeline.

situation.description: What happened to the account? hacked = Hacked (password, email, or phone changed by someone else); noemailphone = Cannot access the old email or phone number; disabled = Disabled by Meta (policy decision); locked = Locked / security checkpoint / new-device prompt; twofa = Lost access with two-factor on (lost phone or authenticator).
